subject.title: feat(kimi): show code quota in usage status

question: Should the bundled Kimi Coding provider automatically poll the managed Kimi usage endpoint for existing Kimi credentials, matching the provider-owned quota-status pattern used by comparable bundled providers?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent and has focused tests plus live endpoint evidence, but choosing to add automatic authenticated quota polling is a product and operator-policy decision that code review cannot infer from the implementation alone.

options.title: Adopt managed-only quota polling
options.body: Approve the provider-owned managed-endpoint hook, keeping custom proxy and mirror URLs excluded from automatic polling.

options.title: Require an explicit enablement path
options.body: Keep Kimi quota support out of the default status flow until maintainers choose a discoverable opt-in or setup experience for the additional authenticated request.

options.title: Defer bundled support
options.body: Leave the current provider behavior unchanged and revisit Kimi quota reporting only when a maintainer sponsors the bundled-status direction.

recommendation.title: Adopt managed-only quota polling
recommendation.body: Approve the provider-owned managed-endpoint hook, keeping custom proxy and mirror URLs excluded from automatic polling.

likelyOwner.reason: This requires repository-level judgment on bundled provider behavior and credentialed status polling, not a contributor-side mechanical fix.
